summary: Wired §9's fruit into MatchRoom. pedestalSites puts one pedestal on each regular island at its highest-id dock (4). The deal comes from deriveSeed('fruit'), with a test-only pin (PIRATE_SEA_RACE_TEST_FRUITS). stepFruits runs each world tick after the encounters and ruin presence, before the holds and the claim. Protocol v9: F is Buttons.Fruit, plus inspect-fruit / fruit-kit (reply to the inspector only, strict zod), per-client pedestal markers (full or empty, in sight) and the player's own kit, progress and last result in their status. Every sea duel's DuelMachine gets both kits: they are fixed in the frame-0 state and synced in the lobby's kits field, and both clients build the same state from them. Web: fruit panel (F inspects, holding F eats, progress ring, every refusal and interruption reason), HUD kit line, duel HUD kits, arena drawing model from fighterTells (bolts, smoke zones, obscured startup flash, reappearance, threats only for striking moves), pedestal markers on the sea. Ruins P2 items: the panel keydown router skips text fields, a Digit1-6 vs tablet-order test, an exact lockout test, and an open-water test; row 20 is now removed. Docs: architecture 'Fruits in the room', duel.md note, README. Branch table docs/fruit-kits-online-coverage.md: 135 rows (116 tested, 8 equivalent, 11 removed), built by deleting each branch on scratch copies outside the repo. Checks run on the final code: npm ci at the start; typecheck OK; test:unit 1352/1352; test:integration 124/124 in 177 s; build and smoke OK; full Playwright suite 14/14 with the JSON report, which check-report accepts (fruit-duel included).
open_assumptions: The opponent receives the kit in the duel lobby's synced 'kits' field (in the two fighters' views only, from the reservation). There is no separate duel-start message; the integration test checks raw frames.

Casting off while eating ends with the fruit rules' reason 'released'. The panel shows it as 'You cast off' when the player is no longer at a pedestal. A stream that lapses (250 ms) before the room records the drop also ends as 'released'.
While F stays down at the pedestal the player just emptied, the per-tick 'already-eaten' refusal doesn't replace the meal as their last result.
Threat hitboxes are still drawn only under the developer toggle, as before, but only for strikesWithHitbox moves. Bolts, smoke zones, the obscured startup flash and the reappearance are always drawn.

ruins-online row 20: the room's at-sea check in receiveOpenRuin was redundant with the rules, so it was removed. The row is now 'removed' and cites the new open-water test, because deleting that check can't make any test fail.
falsifying_check: integration (tests/integration/fruits.test.ts), with browser (tests/e2e/fruitDuel.spec.ts [scenario:fruit-duel]) for the page
verify_yourself: That syncing both kits in the duel lobby (the fighters' views only, from the grapple's reservation) satisfies 'a player's kit reaches the opponent only in the duel start'.
